optimized_sql:
WITH cd_demo AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
),
d_date AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
promo AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
)
SELECT item.i_item_id,
       SUM(f.qty_avg * f.qty_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(f.qty_cnt), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(f.list_avg * f.list_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(f.list_cnt), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(f.coupon_avg * f.coupon_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(f.coupon_cnt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(f.sales_avg * f.sales_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(f.sales_cnt), 0) AS agg4
FROM (SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
      FROM item
      ORDER BY i_item_id) AS item
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT AVG(ss_quantity) AS qty_avg,
           COUNT(ss_quantity) AS qty_cnt,
           AVG(ss_list_price) AS list_avg,
           COUNT(ss_list_price) AS list_cnt,
           AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_avg,
           COUNT(ss_coupon_amt) AS coupon_cnt,
           AVG(ss_sales_price) AS sales_avg,
           COUNT(ss_sales_price) AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
      AND ss_cdemo_sk IN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM cd_demo)
      AND ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM d_date)
      AND ss_promo_sk IN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promo)
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) AS f ON true
GROUP BY item.i_item_id
ORDER BY item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
